analysis_plan.estimand_note: risk_difference is in percentage points; relative_lift is a relative percent change vs control. They are not interchangeable.

metric_definitions.auuc: normalized cumulative gain (area under uplift curve)
metric_definitions.uplift_at_k: treated-minus-control conversion in top-k by score
metric_definitions.policy_value: IPW and DR policy value using the known propensity
metric_definitions.calibration: equal-count bins of predicted uplift vs observed treated-minus-control rate
metric_definitions.tie_handling: curves evaluated at distinct-score block boundaries with linear connection; cutoff metrics interpolate cumulative weighted sums inside straddling tie blocks
metric_definitions.constant_policies: treat-none/treat-all are constant policies (control/treated mean via known propensity), excluded from ranking metrics and calibration
metric_definitions.policy_gain: policy value at each budget minus the treat-all constant value and minus the random policy value
